change.title: Apply discount codes to the cart total
change.author: mishal

criterion.text: Applying a valid discount code must reduce the total returned by calculateTotal.

requirement.text: Discount codes: applying a valid code reduces the cart total by the code's percentage, and the reduced total is what every surface renders.

designConstraints.text: Discounts are applied inside calculateTotal so the checkout UI and the pricing API can never disagree about the total.
